net.PlanningReserveMeaning: Twice the observed-maximum replay scenario plus ten minutes for added Git/hash/log overhead and host variability; planning allowance only, enforced runner deadline remains 10800 seconds.
net.AllocationMeaning: Cumulative allocation churn over measured loops, potentially multiple terabytes; not live/retained heap or peak RAM. Excludes setup/warmup/cold allocation. GC behavior may be nonlinear.
net.BudgetBoundary: Clock starts on coordinator entry before package/Git/tool/build checks; includes every cold process, warmup, retained cohort, measured loop, setup, hash and logging stage. Child deadline min(300, remaining runner budget). Partial artifacts remain failed on timeout.
